In each of his first two UCLA games, he scored three touchdowns.

## San Diego State Aztecs vs. UCLA Bruins: Full Highlights

* * *

By AP

Updated: Sep 13, 2026, 04:07 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

PASADENA, Calif. -- — [Wayne Knight](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4912342/wayne-knight) scored three touchdowns after a scoreless first half and UCLA defeated San Diego State 28-10 on Saturday to win its home opener under new coach [Bob Chesney](https://apnews.com/article/ucla-football-preview-d064b6be7ca2ddea4bea3310ea34806b) .

Knight scored on runs of 8 yards in the third and 7 and 36 yards in the fourth, the James Madison transfer's second straight game with three TDs. He had that many in a season-opening [win at California](https://apnews.com/article/ucla-cal-score-9ff32fe534311227b9de34149a28b329) last week.
